pipelineLogs.message: The dataset file was received by the backend.
Rows and columns are ready for checking.
Columns were inspected.
Missing cells were measured.
Text-like columns were separated from numbers.
A target column was searched for.
IDs, timestamps, and constant columns were removed from training.
Known labels were converted to 0 for normal and 1 for anomaly.
Each numeric column used a scale that fits its outlier level.
The first clean normal-looking records will initialize the static detector.
Clean historical rows were selected for the first concept.
This model learns normal behaviour from historical data.
Enhanced Dymeter MANN is fixed before run: maxEpochs=2000, no early stopping.
The static detector learned compact normal patterns.
Neural epoch budget was not consumed because PCA fallback was selected.
pipelineLogs.detail: Stopped at epoch 0; no checkpoint search.

pipelineLogs.message: Rows with larger reconstruction error are more unusual.
The controller checks whether normal behaviour has changed.
A small network estimates how the detector should move for a changed concept.
The decision boundary was recalibrated from recent scores.
Every row received a score, threshold, and decision.
PyTorch was not available, so the compatible PCA fallback was used.
Clear images, a report, and a zipped image folder were saved for this run.
